title: Good for scanning - crashes a lot
text: Have scanned around 3000 pages of old books with this and it usually does a great job correcting page curl etc., however, I find with handwritten books it frequently crashes when scanning much more than 20 pages.  To be fair it usually saves the scans to photos (in a randomish order) but it is a real pain.   It also has a poor OCR (by today’s standards) esp with older typeset books so I always end up using Claude to extract the text

title: Does the job could be better
text:
It basically does the job but more often than not, when I look at the resulted text is blurry and smudged instead of crisp. It’s better if I use the camera then import, which is not ideal. 
The other thing is exposure. Most of the time you want to scan documents and documents are white but cameras look at white and think it’s overexposed so you get grey paper then you have to use an ‘enhancement’ to brighten the page. If the exposure were correct in the first place we wouldn’t have to ‘enhance’.
